TRANSPARENCY BY DESIGN

What this version does, and what it does not

This independent planning workspace recreates the estimating and coordination workflow of the supplied “Skyscraper HVAC Simulator · 3D / 4D / Estimating / Head-loss (v4, example data)”. It uses a new, deterministic example dataset, not an extraction of a real building. The source file is retained unchanged for its richer educational plant, psychrometric and hydraulic demonstrations.

Open the original simulator reference ↗ · Original calculations have not been certified or repaired by this rebuild.

Transparent quantity and labor model

Coordination limits

The duct editor uses axis-aligned segments and an isometric projection. The sample has separate interactive 3D geometry, while the original tower retains its own WebGL scene. Neither is a certified BIM model. Bounding boxes conservatively approximate round geometry; false positives are possible. Checks do not know connections, structural elements, insulation, seismic supports, code requirements or routing intent. Quantity duplicates affect cost but are not separate geometric objects.

Persistence and privacy

Edits are saved to this browser where storage is available. JSON exports include project geometry, assumptions, segment progress and a baseline. Imports are validated before replacing the current project and are undoable. No backend or team synchronization is implemented. This app makes no external data requests.

Engineering boundaries

No claim of ASHRAE, SMACNA, code or manufacturer compliance. No load sizing, pressure-loss network solution, equipment selection, fluid or thermal simulation is performed by this new planner. Currency labels do not perform foreign-exchange conversion. A qualified engineer and estimator must review project-specific geometry, coefficients, material thickness and rates.
